newsitem.title: FRANCE: Matra, Renault in transport accord.
newsitem.headline: Matra, Renault in transport accord.

text.p: Matra Transport International, a unit of the Lagardere Groupe, and Renault SA's trucks division Renault V.I. announced on Tuesday that they had signed a letter of intention to produce urban transport vehicles.
They said in a statement that they expected to present the first prototypes in the first quarter of 1997.
The market for such vehicles is growing rapidly in mid-sized cities and in the suburbs of larger cities. The companies said their system would provide transport for up to 3,000 people per hour.
The vehicles would have electric motors, speed comparable to that of tramcars and a capacity for 100-150 people per vehicle.
